titleEn: How Google Finds and Indexes Your Renovation Website: Crawlability and Indexability for Home Service Businesses
titleZh: 谷歌如何发现和索引您的装修网站：大温哥华地区装修公司的抓取与索引技术指南
contentEn:
If Google cannot crawl your renovation website, it cannot rank. Crawlability determines whether a search engine bot can access your pages; indexability determines whether it stores them in the search results. For home service businesses in Metro Vancouver — competing for keywords like "kitchen renovation Vancouver" or "bathroom contractor Richmond" — both steps must work flawlessly. This guide explains exactly how search engines process renovation websites, using real technical signals from reno-stars.com as the example.

Why Crawlability Is the First Hurdle for Renovation Websites

Search engines send bots — called crawlers — to discover new pages. For a renovation company with pages covering 14 Metro Vancouver cities and 11 services, crawlers must be able to reach each of those URLs. If a page loads behind JavaScript that the bot cannot execute, the content is invisible. If a page is blocked in robots.txt, it is not crawled. If two pages contain identical content, the bot may index only one.

The three signals that matter most for crawlability are: server-side or static HTML delivery (not client-side JavaScript), correct robots.txt configuration, and an XML sitemap that lists every indexable URL. Renovation companies with large site architectures — service pages, city pages, blog posts, project galleries — need all three working together, or some pages will never be discovered.

How Next.js Handles Rendering for Renovation Company Pages

Reno Stars' website uses Next.js App Router. By default, pages render on the server — the bot receives complete HTML in the first response. This is the fastest path to indexing. Client-side rendering, by contrast, requires the bot to download JavaScript, execute it, and wait for content to appear. For a renovation company competing in real-time local search results, server-side rendering is the difference between a page indexed in hours and one indexed in weeks.

The JSON-LD structured data embedded in the HTML tells Google exactly what the business is. The Organization schema on reno-stars.com declares the business type as HomeAndConstructionBusiness, lists all 14 served cities, and includes the phone number and address. This data appears directly in Google's knowledge panel and supports rich results in local search.

Hreflang Tags and International Versions for Renovation Sites

For renovation companies targeting both English and Chinese-speaking clients in Vancouver, hreflang tags signal to search engines which language version of a page to show to which audience. If the same URL serves content in both languages without hreflang markup, Google may show the wrong version to a searcher — or suppress both from search results entirely.

The reno-stars.com site declares alternate language versions using hreflang markup in the HTML head. Each locale — English (en), Simplified Chinese (zh), Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant), and 11 others — is declared as an alternate version of the same page. This ensures search engines serve the correct language version based on the searcher's browser settings and location.

Internal Linking Architecture for Renovation Service Pages

Crawlers discover pages by following links. A renovation website with zero internal links is a dead end — the crawler arrives at the homepage and has nowhere to go. A site with 11 service types and 14 service area cities needs a linking structure that ensures every combination a customer might search is reachable within three clicks from the homepage.

The audit of reno-stars.com shows a service page, an area page, and a blog post for each major city. Internal links from the service area pages to relevant blog posts, and from blog posts to project galleries and service pages, form a connected graph that crawlers traverse completely. A site with 50 to 100 total internal links has good crawlability; a site with fewer than 20 may leave pages undiscovered.

Image Optimization for Renovation Photography

Renovation companies depend on photography to sell their work. Search engines cannot see a photo — they read the surrounding HTML. Every image on a renovation page should carry descriptive alt text that names the room type, material, and location. "White shaker kitchen with quartz island, Richmond" tells both search engines and visually impaired users exactly what the image contains.

Image compression and next-gen formats like WebP also affect crawlability indirectly: fast-loading pages rank higher in Core Web Vitals, and a slow page may be crawled less frequently. For a renovation project gallery where page weight is dominated by photography, image optimization directly affects how often Googlebot revisits the page.

Canonical Tags and Duplicate Content on Renovation Websites

Duplicate content confuses search engines. If the same renovation service page is accessible at three different URLs — with and without a trailing slash, with and without www — the crawler splits ranking signals across all three versions instead of concentrating them on one. Canonical tags tell Google which version is the "real" page that should appear in search results.

A properly configured renovation site sets a canonical URL on every page that points to itself, and ensures that alternate language versions use hreflang tags to declare their relationship to each other. Combined with correct robots.txt and an XML sitemap, these three files — robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and hreflang — form the foundation of crawlability for any multilingual renovation company.

Frequently Asked Questions About Crawlability for Renovation Companies

Why is my renovation website not appearing in Google search results?

The most common reasons are: the page is blocked in robots.txt, the page requires JavaScript that Googlebot cannot execute, the page has a noindex directive, or the page has no internal links pointing to it so crawlers never discover it. Check URL Inspection in Google Search Console for the specific status of any page.

Does client-side rendering hurt my renovation company's local SEO?

Yes. Client-side rendering means Googlebot receives an empty HTML shell and must execute JavaScript to see content. Googlebot has a crawl budget and a rendering budget — both are limited. Server-side rendering ensures content is available immediately, which improves both indexing speed and Core Web Vitals scores.

How do hreflang tags help a multilingual renovation business in Vancouver?

Hreflang tags tell Google which language version of a page to serve to which searcher. For a renovation company that serves English, Mandarin, and Cantonese speakers in Metro Vancouver, hreflang markup ensures that a Chinese-language searcher sees the Chinese version of the page, and an English-language searcher sees the English version. Without hreflang, Google may show the wrong language or suppress both from results.

What is the ideal internal linking structure for a renovation website?

A service-oriented renovation site should have every service page linked from the main navigation, every city page linked from a service area index, and blog posts linked from both service and city pages. Each blog post should link to at least one relevant project and the contact page. A total of 50 to 100 internal links across the site is a healthy target; fewer than 20 total links risks orphan pages that crawlers never discover.

How many images should a renovation company website have per project page?

Ten to fifteen high-quality project photos per page is the practical range. Each image needs descriptive alt text naming the room, material, and city. All images should be compressed and served in WebP format. More images improve engagement but increase page weight — keeping total page weight below 2MB ensures fast loading and better Core Web Vitals scores.

contentZh:
如果谷歌无法抓取您的装修网站，该网站就无法获得排名。抓取能力决定搜索引擎爬虫能否访问您的页面；索引能力决定它是否会在搜索结果中存储这些页面。对于大温哥华地区的装修公司而言——在「温哥华厨房装修」或「列治文浴室承包商」等关键词上竞争——这两个步骤都必须完美运行。本指南详细解释搜索引擎如何处理装修网站，以 reno-stars.com 的真实技术信号作为示例。

为什么抓取能力是装修网站的第一个障碍

搜索引擎派出爬虫来发现新页面。对于一家在14个大温城市和11种服务类型上都有页面的装修公司，爬虫必须能够触及每一个URL。如果某个页面在爬虫无法执行的 JavaScript 后面加载，内容就不可见。如果页面在 robots.txt 中被阻止，就不会被抓取。如果两个页面包含相同内容，爬虫可能只索引其中一个。

对抓取能力影响最大的三个信号是：服务器端或静态 HTML 交付（非客户端 JavaScript）、正确的 robots.txt 配置，以及列出每个可索引 URL 的 XML 网站地图。拥有大型网站架构的装修公司——服务页面、城市页面、博客文章、项目图库——需要三者协同工作，否则某些页面将永远无法被发现。

Next.js 如何处理装修公司页面的渲染

Reno Stars 网站使用 Next.js App Router。默认情况下，页面在服务器上渲染——爬虫在第一次响应中收到完整的 HTML。这是索引最快的路径。相比之下，客户端渲染要求爬虫下载 JavaScript、执行它，然后等待内容出现。对于在实时本地搜索结果中竞争的装修公司，服务器端渲染是页面在数小时内被索引还是数周内被索引的区别。

嵌入在 HTML 中的 JSON-LD 结构化数据直接告诉谷歌该企业的类型。reno-stars.com 上的 Organization schema 将企业类型声明为 HomeAndConstructionBusiness，列出所有14个服务城市，并包含电话号码和地址。这些数据直接显示在谷歌的知识面板中，并支持本地搜索中的丰富结果。

装修网站的 hreflang 标签和国际版本

对于在温哥华同时面向英语和中文客户的装修公司，hreflang 标签向搜索引擎发出信号，告诉它向哪个受众显示哪个语言版本的页面。如果相同的 URL 在没有 hreflang 标记的情况下提供两种语言的内容，谷歌可能会向搜索者显示错误版本——或者将两个版本都从搜索结果中删除。

reno-stars.com 网站使用 HTML head 中的 hreflang 标记来声明备用语言版本。每种语言——英语 (en)、简体中文 (zh)、繁体中文 (zh-Hant) 及其他11种——都被声明为同一页面的备用版本。这确保搜索引擎根据搜索者的浏览器设置和位置提供正确的语言版本。

装修服务页面的内部链接架构

爬虫通过跟随链接来发现页面。没有内部链接的装修网站是一条死路——爬虫到达首页后就无处可去。拥有11种服务类型和14个服务城市地区的网站需要一个链接结构，确保客户可能搜索的每个组合都能在从首页点击三次内到达。

对 reno-stars.com 的审计显示，每个主要城市都有一个服务页面、一个地区页面和一个博客文章。从服务地区页面到相关博客文章、从博客文章到项目图库和服务页面的内部链接，形成了一个爬虫可以完全遍历的连接图。拥有50到100个总内部链接的网站具有良好的抓取能力；少于20个的网站可能会让页面成为孤立页面，永远不会被爬虫发现。

装修摄影的图片优化

装修公司依靠摄影来展示他们的工作。搜索引擎看不到照片——它们阅读周围的 HTML。装修页面上每张图片都应带有描述性 alt 文本，命名房间类型、材料和位置。「温哥华白色橱柜厨房配石英石台面」告诉搜索引擎和视障用户图片的具体内容。

图片压缩和 WebP 等下一代格式也间接影响抓取能力：加载速度快的页面在 Core Web Vitals 中排名更高，加载缓慢的页面可能会被更不频繁地抓取。对于项目图库页面（页面重量由摄影主导），图片优化直接影响谷歌爬虫重新访问页面的频率。

装修网站上的规范标签和重复内容

重复内容会让搜索引擎感到困惑。如果相同的装修服务页面可通过三个不同的 URL 访问——带和不带斜杠、带和不带 www——爬虫会将排名信号分散到所有三个版本上，而不是集中在一个版本上。规范标签告诉谷歌哪个版本是应该出现在搜索结果中的「真实」页面。

配置正确的装修网站在每个页面上设置一个规范 URL 指向其自身，并确保备用语言版本使用 hreflang 标签来声明彼此之间的关系。结合正确的 robots.txt 和 XML 网站地图，这三个文件——robots.txt、sitemap.xml 和 hreflang——构成了任何多语言装修公司抓取能力的基础。

关于装修公司抓取能力的常见问题

为什么我的装修网站没有出现在谷歌搜索结果中？

最常见的原因是：页面在 robots.txt 中被阻止、页面需要谷歌爬虫无法执行的 JavaScript、页面有 noindex 指令，或者页面没有指向它的内部链接，因此爬虫永远不会发现它。在 Google Search Console 的 URL 检查中查看任何页面的具体状态。

客户端渲染会损害我的装修公司的本地 SEO 吗？

是的。客户端渲染意味着谷歌爬虫收到一个空的 HTML 框架，必须执行 JavaScript 才能看到内容。谷歌爬虫有抓取预算和渲染预算——两者都是有限的。服务器端渲染确保内容立即可用，这既提高了索引速度，也改善了 Core Web Vitals 分数。

hreflang 标签如何帮助温哥华的多语言装修企业？

hreflang 标签告诉谷歌向哪个搜索者提供哪个语言版本的页面。对于在大温哥华地区为英语、普通话和粤语使用者提供服务的装修公司，hreflang 标记确保中文搜索者看到页面的中文版本，英语搜索者看到英语版本。没有 hreflang，谷歌可能会显示错误语言或将两者都从结果中删除。

装修网站的理想内部链接结构是什么？

以服务为导向的装修网站应将每个服务页面链接到主导航，将每个城市页面链接到服务区域索引，并将博客文章从服务和城市页面链接。每个博客文章应至少链接到一个相关项目和联系页面。网站上总计50到100个内部链接是健康的目标；少于20个总链接可能会导致孤立页面，爬虫永远无法发现。

装修公司网站每个项目页面应该有多少张图片？

每个页面10到15张高质量项目照片是实际范围。每张图片都需要描述性 alt 文本命名房间、材料和城市。所有图片都应压缩并以 WebP 格式提供。更多图片改善参与度但增加页面重量——将总页面重量保持在2MB以下可确保快速加载和更好的 Core Web Vitals 分数。
